correctness.rationale: The case analysis of each private-leaf pair yields exactly (2,0) on core 2-vertices, (0,1) on their external neighbors, and independent (0,2)/(1,1) choices outside their closed neighborhood; it is both necessary and sufficient under single-label reduction. The sum, independent-set bijection, minimum-weight and leading-coefficient identities are derived algebraically. Direct brute force on 86 base graphs (1,075,446 labelings) and 16 biclique parameter cases found full agreement. Finite checks do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The result exactly enumerates all pointwise-minimal Roman functions by weight for every leaf corona, a naturally large class parameterized by arbitrary base graphs. It identifies a reversible independent-set correspondence, recovers gamma(H) from the least weight, gives a component-size product for the top coefficient, and yields an explicit unequal biclique formula. This genuinely refines known general enumeration methods and scalar domination information without inventing an efficient algorithm.
